title: GPU
description: UUID of the NVIDIA GPU models run on (GPU-… or MIG-…). Leave empty to use the card with the most free memory at load time; if the saved card is gone, the load uses that card and says so. Applies from the next model load.

controllerProps.placeholder: Card with the most free memory

title: Context Length
description: Maximum prompt plus reply length in tokens, fixed when the model starts. A longer request is refused with context_length_exceeded instead of restarting the model. Applies from the next model load.

title: Max Output Tokens
description: Longest reply per request. Atomic Chat caps each request's max_tokens to this value on its way to the model; it is not an engine setting. Must be less than the context length. Applies from the next model load.

title: KV Cache Memory Fraction
description: Share of the GPU memory still free after the weights load that the engine reserves for its KV cache. Applies from the next model load.

title: Parallel Requests
description: How many requests the engine serves at once (chat, agent and API together); more wait in a queue. Hybrid models such as Qwen3.5 reserve memory for each one up front, so a higher value needs more GPU memory. Applies from the next model load.

title: KV Cache Token Limit
description: Upper bound of the KV cache in tokens. 0 sizes it for every parallel request at the full context length. The engine uses the smaller of this and the KV cache memory fraction; hybrid models such as Qwen3.5 need it to start. Applies from the next model load.

title: CUDA Graphs
description: Speeds up token generation, but takes extra GPU memory (about 2 GB for a small model) and a few seconds at load. Auto turns them on only on cards with 12 GB of memory or more, so a model still fits on a small card. Applies from the next model load.

title: KV Cache Precision
description: FP8 halves the KV cache memory, so a longer context fits, at a small quality cost on very long contexts. Needs an Ada (RTX 40) or newer card; on older cards it is ignored and the model's own precision is used. Applies from the next model load.

title: Load Timeout (seconds)
description: How long a load may take before it fails. 0 estimates it from the model's size. Applies from the next model load.

title: Prefix Caching
description: Reuses the KV cache of a prompt start the engine has already seen (the system prompt, earlier turns of a chat), so a follow-up reads only what is new. Turn it off only to rule it out when chasing a problem. Applies from the next model load.

title: Overlap Scheduler
description: Plans the engine's next step while the card runs the current one, which speeds up generation. Turn it off only if a model misbehaves with it. Applies from the next model load.

title: Scheduler Policy
description: How the engine admits parallel requests. Guaranteed no evict starts a request only when the KV cache can hold it to the end; max utilization starts more at once and pauses some when the cache runs out. Matters only with more than one parallel request. Applies from the next model load.

title: Weight Precision
description: Precision of the model's unquantized weights and activations. Auto takes the model's own. A quantized model keeps its quantized weights either way. Applies from the next model load.

title: Default Temperature
description: Temperature for a request that does not set one, from 0 to 2. Empty leaves it to the engine. A request's own value always wins. Applies from the next model load or reload.

title: Default Top P
description: Top P for a request that does not set one, above 0 and up to 1. Empty leaves it to the engine. A request's own value always wins. Applies from the next model load or reload.

title: Default Top K
description: Top K for a request that does not set one; -1 or 0 turns it off. Empty leaves it to the engine. A request's own value always wins. Applies from the next model load or reload.

title: Default Min P
description: Min P for a request that does not set one, from 0 to 1. Empty leaves it to the engine. A request's own value always wins. Applies from the next model load or reload.

title: Default Repetition Penalty
description: Repetition penalty for a request that does not set one, above 0 (1 is none). Empty leaves it to the engine. A request's own value always wins. Applies from the next model load or reload.
